描述_EN: chambers was born in sweden and died in london. chambers moved to london in 1755 and published his influential treatise on civil architecture in 1759. chambers demonstrated the breadth of his style in buildings such as gower (later carrington) house and melbourne house, london, in such country houses as duddingston, scotland, and in the garden architecture he designed for wilton house, wiltshire, and at kew gardens. the upper two borders are variations on chambers’s favourite running scroll, the bottom one a more fanciful composition of waving leaves, perhaps more attributable to yenn. he travelled widely, visiting china, and studied architecture at the ecole des arts, paris, from 1749 and in italy from 1750 to 1755. he became head of government building in 1782, and in this capacity built somerset house, london. many of his drawings from this period are contained in his important 'franco-italian' album, held in the v&a. elevations, three on one sheet, for metal borders of rooms by john yenn (1750-1821) from the office of sir william chambers (1723-1796). no other designs for these are known from the chambers circle. this drawing copies another or others and is included here because it is unclear if the borders, designed to conceal the edges of textile wall covering, are designed by chambers or by yenn.
描述_ZN: 钱伯斯生于瑞典，死于伦敦。 钱伯斯于1755年搬到伦敦，并于1759年发表了他的有影响力的民用建筑论文。 钱伯斯在伦敦的高尔（后来的卡灵顿）屋和梅尔本屋等建筑中，在苏格兰的杜丁斯顿等乡间别墅中，以及在他为威尔特郡的威尔顿屋和邱园设计的花园建筑中，展示了他风格的广泛性。 上面两个边框是钱伯斯最喜欢的卷轴的变体，下面一个是更富想象力的挥舞的叶子的组成，也许更应该归功于Yenn。 他游历广泛，访问过中国，从1749年开始在巴黎的艺术学院学习建筑，从1750年到1755年在意大利学习建筑。 他在1782年成为政府建筑的负责人，并以这个身份建造了伦敦的Somerset House。 他在这一时期的许多画作都包含在他重要的 "法国-意大利 "画册中，由V&A收藏。 仰视图，三张在一张纸上，用于房间的金属边框，作者是John Yenn (1750-1821)，来自William Chambers先生(1723-1796)的办公室。 在钱伯斯的圈子里没有其他设计。 这幅画复制了另一幅或其他的画，并被包括在这里，因为不清楚这些旨在掩盖纺织墙面边缘的边框是由钱伯斯还是由耶恩设计的。
